stories.title: Wirtschaftsweise Veronika Grimm kritisiert neuen Tankrabatt scharf

en.title: Economic advisor Veronika Grimm criticizes new fuel tax cut sharply
en.summary: Veronika Grimm, a German economic advisor, argues that a planned fuel price relief measure harms younger generations and warns that such short-sighted actions could have serious long-term consequences.

stories.title: Hohe Spritpreise: Wirtschaftsweise Grimm nennt Tankrabatt »zynisch«

en.title: High fuel prices: Economic advisor Grimm calls fuel tax cut "cynical"
en.summary: The government reintroduces a fuel tax cut, which economist Veronika Grimm criticizes as short-sighted because it disadvantages younger generations.

stories.title: Karibik: US-Militär tötet erneut vier Menschen auf angeblichem Schmugglerboot

en.title: Caribbean: US military kills four people on alleged smuggler boat
en.summary: The United States continues military operations against vessels on drug trafficking routes in the Caribbean, reporting four deaths of suspected narco-terrorists without providing evidence.

stories.title: USA töten vier Menschen auf mutmaßlichem Drogenboot in der Karibik

en.title: USA kills four people on suspected drug boat in Caribbean
en.summary: US military forces fired on a ship in Caribbean waters, resulting in deaths. While Washington claims evidence of drug smuggling, it does not provide public documentation of such evidence.

stories.title: Irankrieg: Huthi-Miliz bekennt sich zu Angriffen auf Riad

en.title: Iran war: Houthi militia claims attacks on Riyadh
en.summary: Houthi rebels allied with Iran attacked Saudi Arabia's capital with rockets and drones. Iran also executed a person it claimed was an Israeli spy.

stories.title: Huthi-Miliz reklamiert Angriffe in Saudi-Arabien für sich

en.title: Houthi militia claims attacks in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The Houthi militia in Yemen claimed responsibility for recent attacks on targets in Saudi Arabia. Residents in Riyadh reported explosions and a smoke plume near the international airport.

stories.title: Gladbach verliert auch unter Lichte gegen Mainz

en.title: Gladbach loses to Mainz under Lichte
en.summary: Borussia Mönchengladbach suffered a defeat against 1. FSV Mainz 05 in the Bundesliga under interim coach Jan-Moritz Lichte, with weak defensive performance cited as a key factor.

stories.title: Donald Trump kündigt »AI Force« zur KI-Überwachung an

en.title: Donald Trump announces "AI Force" for AI surveillance
en.summary: US President Donald Trump plans to establish a new institution to oversee artificial intelligence development, including an AI czar position, despite previously dismissing concerns about AI risks.

stories.title: Jemen-Krieg: Rauchsäule nahe Flughafen – Huthi-Miliz meldet Angriffe auf Riad

en.title: Yemen war: Smoke column near airport – Houthi militia reports attacks on Riyadh
en.summary: Houthi fighters reportedly attacked an oil facility near Riyadh's international airport, prompting air raid alerts and causing flight cancellations and delays.

stories.title: US-Präsident Trump verwehrt ausgewählten Medien Zutritt zum Weißen Haus

en.title: US President Trump denies access to selected media outlets at White House
en.summary: US President Trump has restricted certain media organizations from entering the White House.

stories.title: Generalinspekteur Breuer wird Vorsitzender des NATO-Militärausschusses

en.title: Inspector General Breuer becomes chairman of NATO Military Committee
en.summary: Inspector General Breuer has been elected as the new chairman of NATO's Military Committee, one of the alliance's most influential positions, and will serve as an advisor to NATO Secretary General Rutte.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Signal aus Teheran – Iran will zurück zu Rahmenabkommen

en.title: +++ Iran War +++: Signal from Tehran – Iran wants to return to framework agreement
en.summary: South Korea pledges support to the US for securing the Strait of Hormuz. Iran has communicated conditions to the US for ending the conflict.

stories.title: Analyse: Trump beendet die Grönland-Krise vorerst - aber ein Problem bleibt

en.title: Analysis: Trump ends Greenland crisis for now - but one problem remains
en.summary: President Trump and supporters characterize a US-Denmark agreement as a historic victory, though experts acknowledge progress while questioning this assessment.

stories.title: Verteidigung: General Carsten Breuer übernimmt Vorsitz des Nato-Militärausschusses

en.title: Defense: General Carsten Breuer assumes chairmanship of NATO military committee
en.summary: The NATO military committee has elected Germany's highest-ranking military officer, General Carsten Breuer, as successor to Italian Admiral Cavo Dragone as chairman.

stories.title: Regierung: Zwei Wahlen und das Schicksal der Koalition: Das steht für Merz, Bas und Klingbeil auf dem Spiel

en.title: Government: Two elections and the fate of the coalition: What is at stake for Merz, Bas and Klingbeil
en.summary: Upcoming elections in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern will impact the stability of the German federal government and test the political positions of CDU and SPD leaders.

stories.title: Russland Kriegskasse: Wladimir Putins mächtige Schattenflotte

en.title: Russia's War Chest: Vladimir Putin's Powerful Shadow Fleet
en.summary: Despite international sanctions, Russia continues selling large quantities of oil through alternative routes and distribution hubs, channeling billions into military funding, according to data analysis.
